author: Jtburkh
quote:
I could try and write a long review and say a lot of good things about what Larian has done here.  Truth is, it doesn't need an explanation.  It's a great game.  Well done Larian!

Do yourself a favor and just go play it.

author: Jtburkh
quote:
I have put about 7 hours into the game, and have to say, it's a great game.  Sometimes spiritual successors are a little pale in comparison to their original inspiration, but not this game.

It is a marked improvement over the original games and I am much appreciated that it was made.  It brought back the same sort of enjoyment I had playing those games when they originally came out in the 90's, except it's augmented for the modern era.  Great fun!

game_title: Grand Theft Auto: The Trilogy - The Definitive Edition

author: Jtburkh
quote: The installer and opening scenes cracked me up - I'm glad I don't have to screw around with sound cards and IRQs anymore...     The gameplay is fun, and still difficult.  These old games have stood the test of time and are far more better than anything that's been released in the last few years.   Thanks for remastering this game!

author: Jtburkh
quote: This is simply a cash grab.  It is literally just Fallout 4 with multiplayer and should have been treated as a DLC to Fallout 4.  The graphics are not very good if you compare them to games like RDR2.   The story is ultra boring and does not make sense.  It was kind of cute how fallout 4 had bugs before but it is really just sloppy now.  They must have lost their top tier developers.  Lastly, I think there are some major exploits going on.  I was a level 4 and got PVP killed by another player with 2 shots.  I hadn't fired on this other player and was just exploring.  I don't mind being killed, it just shows how many problems this game has.  Bethesda just has this left over engine sitting around and no talent left in their ranks.  That is plain to see.  I give it a 2 out of 10 because I need to justify to myself that I spent 60 on this, otherwise I would give it a 1.  It's not as bad as No Man's Sky but it's pretty close.
